subject: 清初至清中北方汉地砖佛塔意象（原创扩展；具体细部待考）
prompt: Classic 2:1 ISOMETRIC GAME MAP GEOMETRY with realistic architectural textures, not pixel-art. Create one isolated transparent sprite of a northern Chinese five-tier gray BRICK Buddhist pagoda with octagonal tapering shaft, corbelled masonry tier cornices and small simple finial, standing on a thin SQUARE stone footing, no Tibetan stupa form. Exact orthographic45-degree azimuth30-degree elevation, both ground axes slope precisely 1 vertical unit per 2 horizontal units, front-left edge+0.5 and front-right edge-0.5. The rectangular base is 7 meters east-west by 7 meters north-south, projected front-left edge 7 units and front-right edge 7 units. South entrance faces lower-left. Draw the entire thin rectangular base with clear left/front/right corners, correct2:1 diamond form, no tall pedestal. Northern China early-to-mid Qing original historical-game module. Warm-neutral soft top-left lighting; tiny contact shadow only. Fine gray tile and gray brick material details, restrained realism matching a Song-era city-building kit. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND; no glow, halo, mist, shadows around silhouette, no floor, no backdrop. Keep complete silhouette comfortably inside canvas with15% fully transparent margin all sides. No visible writing, numbers, guides, modern elements, people, scenery or checkerboard. Asset bld_kit_qing_north_pagoda.
negative: 文字、水印、现代元素、人物、景观背景、厚地台、裁切、透视汇聚、黄色帝王琉璃瓦
created_time_basis: copy2保留的源PNG文件mtime；非工具披露的服务端时间

projection_contract.contract_note: 目标契约；实际源图投影误差见geometry_qa，不能据此宣称所有视角合格。

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding
processing.anchor_transform_note: 锚点按整数重采样尺寸对应的rounded_effective_scale分别作用于源X/Y；图像仍仅做一次名义等比缩放，差异来自像素取整。

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面三角点，±3px不确定性；底面中心取(L+R)/2。后角为L+R−F推算，非3D测绘；未以变形纠偏。

notes: 已逐张view_image检查源图及浅底alpha合成诊断：主体完整、无文字人物现代物；灰砖灰瓦暗木与宋套件细节密度相近，王府绿瓦和官式红柱区分等级。直接PNG预览的灰棕晕属于透明像素RGB，浅底alpha合成无外部光晕；未改alpha。7×7为同构功能件建议占地；六层八角汉地佛塔原创意象，不指认具体名塔或始建年代。 三角点量取在双轴±0.03/轴比10%建议容差内，仍为candidate。 最终PNG已再次逐张view_image自查；历史来源统一见prompts/building-map.md清北节及tools/agents/reports/KIT-qing_north.md §7。 提示词要求五层但候选实际六层；保留实物描述，不将提示词当成图像事实。
